import sys, unicodedata, json, binascii, platform
assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3,14,7)
assert unicodedata.unidata_version == '16.0.0'
assert sys.platform == 'darwin' and sys.byteorder == 'little'
s = json.load(sys.stdin)
for raw, sep, group, expected in s['encode']:
    value = bytes.fromhex(raw)
    actual = binascii.hexlify(value) if sep is None else binascii.hexlify(value, bytes([sep]), group)
    assert actual.hex() == expected, (raw, sep, group)
for raw, expected, message in s['decode']:
    try:
        actual = binascii.unhexlify(bytes.fromhex(raw))
    except binascii.Error as error:
        assert str(error) == message, raw
    else:
        assert message is None and actual.hex() == expected, raw
print(json.dumps(dict(version=sys.version, unicode=unicodedata.unidata_version, platform=platform.platform(), byteorder=sys.byteorder, encode=len(s['encode']), decode=len(s['decode']))))
